competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The flow is developing or statistically stationary.
evidence_for: fx and fy mean values stabilize across later time windows.
evidence_against: fz shows a growing amplitude over time, increasing from ~1e-4 to nearly 7e-3, indicating an unstable or unphysical divergence in the lateral force.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The simulation is numerically unstable or unphysical in the lateral direction.
evidence_for: fz extrema systematically grow in magnitude every half cycle without bound (from -0.00012 to -0.0052).

decision.reasoning_summary: Although the streamwise force fx and vertical force fy appear to reach a steady mean, the lateral force fz exhibits an unbounded, escalating oscillation amplitude over time. This systematic growth in lateral force fluctuations indicates a numerical instability or unphysical feedback loop in the spanwise direction, requiring a safe stop.
